**1 — Scene:** A mixed cooked meal: browned patties or frittata-like pieces, leafy greens, green beans, and a pale rice-and-vegetable mixture. The exact ingredients are uncertain.

**2 — Vessel:** A dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** across. Area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Browned egg/vegetable-style pieces; leafy greens with a few carrot slivers; green beans; white rice; pale cabbage/onion and yellow vegetable pieces. A light oil sheen is visible.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** I treat the browned pieces as egg-and-vegetable patties for this estimate. Rice and pale vegetables are estimated separately, although they overlap visually.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density → grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Browned patties/frittata pieces | 26% | 138 × 1.6 = 221 ml | 0.9 → 199 g | 200 | 398 |
| Leafy greens, carrot slivers | 22% | 117 × 2.5 = 292 ml | 0.2 → 58 g | 35 | 20 |
| Green beans | 10% | 53 × 1.8 = 96 ml | 0.6 → 57 g | 35 | 20 |
| Cooked white rice | 18% | 96 × 1.8 = 172 ml | 0.8 → 138 g | 130 | 179 |
| Pale and yellow vegetables | 12% | 64 × 1.6 = 102 ml | 0.6 → 61 g | 40 | 24 |
| Visible oil sheen | Overlying food | Thin coating, approximately 5 ml | 0.9 → 5 g | 880 | 44 |

Food coverage totals **88%**. Oil overlays the food rather than occupying additional plate area; the other energy values exclude this separately counted oil.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **518 g and 685 kcal** is plausible for this mostly covered dinner plate. The largest uncertainty is the identity and thickness of the browned pieces.
